Description: React project scaffolding: npm create vite@latest.

Name: NestJS
Description: Nest CLI and Node.js.

Name: Express.js
Description: Express is installed per-project, not globally.

Name: Go
Description: Backend profile: Go SDK and common infrastructure.

Name: Java
Description: Backend profile: Temurin JDK and Maven.

Name: Python (backend)
Description: Python backend profile and infrastructure.

Name: Rust (backend)
Description: Rust backend profile and infrastructure.

Name: C
Description: C build environment; may need Windows SDK/linker.

Name: C++
Description: C++ build environment; may need Windows SDK/linker.

Name: Python (standalone)
Description: Python interpreter only.

Name: Rust (standalone)
Description: Rustup; MSVC build tools may also be required.

Name: Lua
Description: Lua runtime.

Name: TypeScript standalone
Description: Install global tsc for standalone usage.

Name: Qt (C++)
Description: Qt is guided (official online installer), not silently installed.

Description: Optional package manager installed through WinGet.

Name: Docker Desktop
Description: Docker Desktop without a backend profile.
